name: Cubes-TS-TW
title: 3D Cube Grid
description: An eight-by-eight field of dashed purple squares sits flat until cells near the pointer rotate into 3D cubes; a click sends rings of pale lilac across the faces.
use: A tech product wants a decorative interactive backdrop that rewards hovering and clicking.
avoid: The dense dashed grid and constant motion can overwhelm copy laid over it, and the ripple is mouse-led.
a11y: Decorative only; the pointer and click effects have no keyboard route and the auto animation ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A square grid of small dark cells with thin purple dashed borders, evenly spaced on black. Cells under the pointer lift into cube shapes with lit faces, and a click turns whole rings of cells pale lilac.
behaves: Cells within a short radius of the pointer tilt on two axes, the nearest most, and ease back when it leaves. Left alone, a virtual pointer wanders the grid; a click washes expanding rings of colour outward.
customise: Grid density, tilt angle and radius, gap, face and border colour, shadow, auto animation, and ripple colour and speed are props. There is no content to pass in.
weight: moderate: Sixty-four cubes with six faces each, all retweened every frame while auto-animating.
